South Indian Meat Masala
By: miansari66
Published: Thursday, August 11, 2011 - 10:50pm

Ingredients




Mutton  1 kg
Tomatoes  chopped 3
Onion chopped 3
Garlic crushed 1 teaspoon
Ginger 1 teaspoon
Oil 1 cup
Fresh Coriander leaves for garnish
Salt to taste
Red Chilli  1 teaspoon
Black pepper 1 teaspoon
Mustard (Black) powder 2 teaspoon
Fenugreek powder 1 teaspoon
Kalaungi powder 1 teaspoon
Coriander powder 1 teaspoon
Garam Masala 1 teaspoon

Preparation

1 Fry onion in oil till brown. 2 Add tomatoes. garlic, ginger and fry for 3-5 minutes. 3 Now add Meat and spices and fry for another 3-5 minutes, and then add 2 cup water and cook on medium flame till meat is tender. 4 Garnish with Fresh coriander leaves and simmer. 5 Delicious South Indian Meat Masala Dish is ready. 6 Serve with Naan/Roti and salad.

About

South Indian Meat Masala is a very tasty and popular dish . Low in Red Chilli and  brownish in colour.
